Certified Time Lord regulation compliant.
Comprised of three different Field Generators with 9 tiers each:
Spacetime Compression: Determines max recipe tier, -3% processing time per tier above recipe (multiplicative)
Time Dilation: -50% recipe duration per tier (multiplicative), -9.25% recipe success chance per tier (additive)
Stabilisation: +5% recipe success chance per tier (additive), -5% yield per tier (additive)
Lower tier stabilisation generators also reduce the total output EU,
starting at -40% with T1 Crude and increases by +5% per tier (additive)
Right-click the controller with a Planet Block to insert it and set the recipe
Base recipe success chance (S) depends on the planet tier
On success, outputs everything listed in NEI. The base yield for fluids starts at 100% before any penalties
On failure, outputs Spacetime = S * 14,400 * 2^(Planet Tier) and any output EU
Pity guarantees a success after several consecutive failures but resets on success or recipe change
Constantly inputs Hydrogen and Helium into its own internal buffer while idle, and consumes everything on recipe start
Exceeding the minimum required amount for a recipe heavily reduces the recipe success chance and yield
Overflow Ratio = (Stored Fluid / Min Fluid) - 1
Penalty% = 1 - exp(-(30 * Overflow Ratio)^2)
Consumes EU directly from the owner's wireless network
Set the desired number of overclocks with a Programmed Circuit in the input bus
Output EU is constant and does not scale with the number of overclocks
Insert Astral Array Fabricators (AA) through an input bus to add parallels (max 8,637)
Each one is rolled independently to determine whether it succeeds or not
Parallel Exponent (PE) = floor(log(8 * AA) / log(1.7))
Parallels = 2^(PE)
When running parallels, there is no more pity and the power changes:
EU Input = Base EU Input * 4^OC * 2.3^PE * 1.63 / 20.7
EU Output = Base EU Output * 2.3^(PE-1) / 9
Also consumes Condensed Raw Stellar Plasma Mixture instead of Hydrogen and Helium:
并行：Raw Stellar Plasma = 12.4 / 10^6 * Helium Amount *

Every tick, Toxic Residue will decrease by Base Decay*Decay Boost*(Toxic Residue^0.08)
Residue will decay 10 times slower when multiblock is disabled
Insert Robot Arms to increase Decay Boost:
Decay Boost is calculated as 1.2^Robot Arm Tier if IV or below, 1.4^Robot Arm Tier if LuV or above
Insert multiple (16 max) robot arms to multiply Decay Boost by sqrt(Robot Arm Amount)
Every minute, Robot Arm Amount/(45*(1+Robot Arm Tier)) chance for one used robot arm to void
Structure has 3 Tiers, Tier determines Base Decay and Capacity:

Machine Type: BEC Generator, Condensate Entangler, Input Hatch
Entangled Condensate can only be transferred via a Bose-Einstein Condensate Conduit.
Condensate will be processed even if there is no space in the network.
Condensate can only be stored in a Bose-Einstein Condensate Containment Field.
Consumes as much fluid as possible, depending on how much EU/t is supplied.
Machine processing time is the max duration of all active recipes.

item:gregtech:gt.blockmachines@15756: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态物质观测阵列
玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态物质观测阵列
Machine Type: BEC Assembler, Observation Array
Supplies nanites, power, and condensate to Bose-Einstein Condensate Teleportation Nodes.
Nanites must be stored in a Nanite Containment Bus.
Different types of nanites can be mixed, but the effective tier will be the lowest of all provided nanites.
Only 30,720 nanites can be provided at once - any additional nanites will be ignored.
Bose-Einstein Condensate Teleportation Nodes will stall if they request more power than the observation array can provide.
A recipe's condensate can be supplied at any time during its crafting.
The recipe will fail if condensate is not supplied by the end.
Crafting speed will be reduced if the network contains condensate that is not requested by the recipe.
If there are more than 3 unrequested condensates in the network while a teleportation node is running, the craft will immediately fail.
item:gregtech:gt.blockmachines@15757: Bose-Einstein Condensate Teleportation Node
玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态物质传送节点
玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态物质传送节点
Machine Type: BEC I/O Node, Input Bus, Output Bus
Teleports items into and out of the Bose-Einstein Condensate Observation Array.
Recipe logic is the same as all other multiblocks.
Condensate does not have to be present for a recipe to start.
Link it to Bose-Einstein Condensate Observation Array using Line-Of-Sight Connector Hatch.
Each item slot in a recipe has an associated nanite tier.
For the teleportation node to progress through an item slot, it must receive a nanite with the same or higher tier.
Excess nanites linearly increase the speed at which recipes are crafted.
Providing a higher tier nanite than is requested slows progress by 2^(provided tier - requested tier) times.
This multiblock's EU/t remains constant even when it is paused, stalled, or slowed down.
Each recipe crafted in parallel increases the EU/t consumed linearly.
This multiblock does not overclock.
The min and max parallels can be configured in the parameters to guarantee exact recipe timings.
Recipes can be forcefully slowed down to compensate for slow automation by the Speed Divisor parameter.
The Nanite Tier Detector Hatch can be used to detect the teleportation node's requested nanites.
The Teleportation Node Controller Hatch can be used to temporarily pause the teleportation node.
Added by: Recursive Pineapple
